recommendation_summary: Right away, set the reviewers for these changes to a group made up of the lead and the two qualified engineers, so any one of them can approve and merge. Point any required-reviewer rule at that group too. Then track the time from ready-for-review to approval to confirm the fix works. Nothing new needs funding, and the reply adds no optional extras. No needs are left unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need changes to stop waiting for approval when the lead is out.
labels.Deleted: Squads and chapters, Jira Align, new tooling, quarterly planning workshops. None of them touch the step where your changes wait.
labels.Bottleneck: Approval. Your last six changes each took under a day to code, then waited three days because the lead was their only reviewer and was away.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing observed directly. I was told the six-change history, that the lead was the sole reviewer and was absent, and that two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve.

note: The reply sets up a bounded reviewer-group fix, explicitly drops the stack the user proposed, and limits its grounding to the facts it was given.
